preconditions.description: Input sizes n, m, and k are within the stated bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k for x in alice_fish) and all(1 <= x <= k for x in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types in Alice's and Bob's catches are integers between 1 and k (inclusive).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(w_sum_alice > w_sum_bob for w_sum_alice in possible_alice_sums() for w_sum_bob in possible_bob_sums()) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a weight assignment where Alice's total weight is strictly greater than Bob's, otherwise 'NO'.
